title: Action receipts grew legs
description: One sloppy noun became a second receipt store. v1.3.0 deletes it, cuts the observed eval databases roughly in half, and sharpens how ztd names events, scores models, and tests Tribunal consensus.
author: Danny

artwork.alt: Two duplicate receipt stores converging into one signed event chain while the redundant receipts table is deleted.
artwork.caption: TWO STORES → ONE EVENT CHAIN

title: Ugly evals, pprof, and the bugs in L2–L5
description: Anthropic gave me a $1,000 grant, and I burned it on Claude Code reviewing ztd. The evaluations started bolted-on and ugly, but they broke production code and exposed bugs across L2–L5.
author: Danny

artwork.alt: A pprof profiling trace and flame graph revealing performance bottlenecks and bugs across governance layers L2 through L5 under evaluation stress.
artwork.caption: EVALS → PPROF → L2–L5 HARDENING

title: The day my evals deleted the repo
description: An eval bug wiped the repo root, git saved the day, and I found out my own evals were skipping the L1–L5 pipeline that would have stopped it.
author: Danny

artwork.alt: A deleted repository restored from git, above the five governance layers the evaluation had skipped.
artwork.caption: DELETED → RESTORED → RETHOUGHT

title: Going public, and finding out onboarding only worked on Linux
description: The repo went public, three release tags never shipped, and onboarding fell over the moment it left Linux. What broke on Windows and macOS, and what's still clunky.
author: Danny

artwork.alt: A ztd release branching into Linux, Windows, and macOS terminals, with three failed release tags before the first published version.
artwork.caption: ONE RELEASE / THREE PLATFORMS

title: From 936 to 2,000 Operators on one Gateway
description: The failed enrollments, profiles, and fixes behind a 2,000-Operator fleet. A field report on what broke, what changed, and what the measurements actually prove.
author: Danny

artwork.alt: A single ztd Gateway at the center of concentric rings of outbound Operators.
artwork.caption: INTENT → VERIFICATION → EXECUTION
